{{Short description|Polish biologist (1952–2019)}}
'''Barbara Tudek''' ({{IPA|pl|barˈba.ra tudɛk}}; 1952 – March 1, 2019) was a Polish [[biologist]] who served as president of the Polish section of the European Environmental Mutagenesis and Genomics Society (EEMGS). In 2019, Tudek was a recipient of the Frits Sobels Award.

==Early life and education==
Barbara Tudek was born in 1952.<ref name="1nekrologi">{{cite web |title=Barbara Tudek, Warszawa |url=http://nekrologi.wyborcza.pl/0,11,,443716,Barbara-Tudek-nekrolog.html |website=nekrologi.wyborcza.pl |accessdate=10 January 2020 |date=6 March 2019}}</ref> On April 27, 1983, she obtained a doctorate from the [[Medical University of Warsaw]]<ref name="eemgs">{{cite web |title=2019 EEMGS Awards - Frits Sobels Award - Prof. dr hab. Barbara Tudek |url=http://www.eemgs.eu/ |website=www.eemgs.eu |publisher=European Environmental Mutagenesis and Genomics Society |accessdate=10 January 2020}}</ref> with the dissertation, ''Badania właściwości mutagennych ropy naftowej i rozpuszczalników stosowanych w przemyśle petrochemicznym jako ocena zagrożenia środowiska naturalnego człowieka'' ("Research on the mutagenic properties of crude oil and solvents used in the petrochemical industry as an assessment of the threat to the human environment"). Afterwards, she affiliated with [[Ludwig Cancer Research|Ludwig Institute for Cancer Research]], [[Toronto]], Canada, receiving a postdoctoral degree on June 5, 2001, on the basis of the dissertation entitled ''Utlenianie i alkilacja zasad DNA - rola pierwotnych i wtórnych uszkodzeń w replikacji i mutagenezie'' ("Oxidation and alkylation of DNA bases - the role of primary and secondary damage in replication and mutagenesis").<ref name="nauka polska.pl">{{cite web |title=Nowa Nauka Polska |url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=11132&_k=1xn1ez |website=nauka-polska.pl |accessdate=10 January 2020}}</ref> After this, she went to the [[Institut Gustave Roussy]], [[Villejuif]], France.<ref name="eemgs" />

==Career==
On June 8, 2006, she received the academic title of professor in biological sciences.<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/> She worked as a full professor at the Institute of Genetics and Biotechnology at the Faculty of Biology at the [[University of Warsaw]] and at the Institute of Biochemistry and Biophysics of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/> She was an active member of the EEMGS)for almost four decades and served as president of the Polish EEMGS section during the period 2002–12.<ref name="eemgs" />

Tudek died March 1, 2019.<ref name="1nekrologi" />

== Selected works ==
{{Scholia}}
* 2000: ''Fapyadenine is a moderately efficient chain terminator for prokaryotic DNA polymerases''<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/>
* 2005: ''Inhibition of DNA repair glycosylases by base analogs and tryptophan pyrolysate, Trp-P-1''<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/>
* 2006: ''Sensory chemiczne i biosensory w kontroli żywności zmodyfikowanej genetycznie. Chemical sensors and biosensors for the control of GM food''<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/>
* 2006: ''Modulation of oxidative DNA damage repair by the diet, inflammation and neoplastic transformation''<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/>
* 2009: ''The effect of early life nutritional exposures on repair and DNA methylation in brain tissue from young piglets''<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/>
* 2009: ''Cockayne syndrome group B protein is engaged in processing of DNA adducts of lipid peroxidation product trans-4-hydroxy-nonenal''<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/>
* 2014: ''Zinc finger oxidation of Fpg/Nei DNA glycosylases by 2-thioxanthine: biochemical and X-ray structural characterzation''<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/>
* 2016: ''Lipid peroxidation in face of DNA damage, DNA repair and other cellular processes''<ref name="nauka polska.pl"/>
